_comment: Repo-local Claude Code settings: keep agents away from generated state and non-Bash reads of secret files. Rules MERGE with user-global settings — they extend, not replace. Bash-level secret-file protection (including .env*, AWS/SSH/netrc/1Password paths) is handled by the global PreToolUse hook at ~/.claude/hooks/deny-env-bash.sh, so this file no longer ships a vendored copy or redundant Bash(... .env*) deny rules.
